remarks: Welcome home to this peaceful top-floor retreat, where a private deck overlooks a serene wooded backdrop. Bathed in natural light, this bright and airy residence offers an inviting open-concept layout, centered around a cozy wood-burning fireplace-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Brand-new wall-to-wall carpeting, along with updated thermopane windows and a sliding glass door, enhance both comfort and energy efficiency.  The beautifully renovated kitchen is a true highlight, featuring sleek quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a new sink, and freshly painted cabinetry-blending modern style with everyday functionality. The bathroom has also been tastefully updated.  Additional features include an under-house garage, a spacious storage room with interior access, and an assigned parking space.  Ideally situated for commuters, this home is within walking distance to public bus lines and the Metro-North train station. Enjoy the best of Norwalk living with nearby beaches, dining, and a wide range of recreational opportunities.  Offering the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and charm-this is an opportunity you won't want to miss!
